newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Highlights of Monday's Commission briefing.
newsitem.headline: Highlights of Monday's Commission briefing.

text.p: Following are highlights of the midday briefing by the European Commission on Monday:

Spokesman Nikolaus van der Pas said Commissioner Edith Cresson and Federation of European Industries Chairman Oursin would hold a joint news conference on Tuesday at 1215/1015 GMT on high technological SMEs financing.

Van der Pas also announced that DGXIII official Frans De Bruine would brief reporters at 1300/1100 GMT on the European ministerial conference on "Global information networks: realising the potential" to take place in Bonn on July 7-8.

In answer to a question, van der Pas said the Commission had the intention to put forward concrete proposals in the field of job creation before the special European Council to take place in November under the Luxembourg Presidency.
The Commission released the following documents:
- IP/97/580: Banking - Commission clarifies freedom to provide services and the concept of "general good".
- IP/97/581: Annual report on investment in the coalmining and iron and steel industries.
